E1295

Git ref `{ref}` not found.

What

Git ref `{ref}` not found.

Why

`--affected-since` (D-JPK-SELECTOR1=C) diffs workspace member input hashes against a git baseline; that ref must resolve to a commit.

Fix

Pass a real branch, tag, or commit (a did-you-mean is offered when a close match exists).
